linuxUpdates.description: Check for and install verified Linux AppImage releases.
linuxUpdates.notice: Self-update is available when running a writable AppImage. Downloads are verified before installation; settings and browser sign-ins stay in their existing folders.
linuxUpdates.status.idle: Check for a newer Linux AppImage.
linuxUpdates.status.preferenceNotSaved: The automatic update preference could not be saved.
linuxUpdates.status.ready: Download verified. Install and restart when ready; exiting without installing discards the download.
linuxUpdates.status.discardFailed: The downloaded update could not be removed.
linuxUpdates.status.waitingToRestart: Waiting for sync and webpages to close safely…
linuxUpdates.status.restartCanceled: Restart canceled. The verified download is ready when you are.
linuxUpdates.installFailed.title: AppImage update could not be installed
linuxUpdates.installFailed.message:
{{error}}
Your launcher settings and browser profiles were not changed.
linuxUpdates.error.requestFailed: The update request could not be completed. Your existing AppImage is unchanged.
linuxUpdates.error.unsupportedVersion: The release version is not a supported stable version.
linuxUpdates.error.unsupportedArchitectu: This architecture does not have an AppImage update target.
linuxUpdates.error.invalidAssets: The release asset list is invalid.
linuxUpdates.error.ambiguousAssets: The release contains ambiguous AppImage assets.
linuxUpdates.error.missingVerification: The Linux AppImage release does not contain valid verification information.
linuxUpdates.error.unsupportedRedirect: The update server returned an unsupported redirect.
linuxUpdates.error.responseTooLarge: The update response is too large.
linuxUpdates.error.serverFailed: GitHub could not complete the update check. Try again later.
linuxUpdates.error.unreachable: Could not check for updates. Check your connection and try again.
linuxUpdates.error.notWritable: Move the AppImage to a writable folder owned by you before self-updating.
linuxUpdates.error.notAppImage: This executable is not a supported AppImage.
linuxUpdates.error.imageUnavailable: The running AppImage is unavailable or not writable.
linuxUpdates.error.imageChanged: The AppImage changed after the download. Check for updates again.
linuxUpdates.error.stagedMissing: The staged update is no longer available.
linuxUpdates.error.stagedVerification: The staged update failed verification. The running AppImage was preserved.
linuxUpdates.error.stagedIncompatible: The staged file is not a compatible AppImage.
linuxUpdates.error.backupUnavailable: The previous-version backup path is unavailable.
linuxUpdates.error.checkBackup: The update could not finish. The previous AppImage backup must be checked before retrying.
linuxUpdates.error.restored: The update could not finish. The previous AppImage was preserved or restored.
linuxUpdates.error.downloadTooLarge: The downloaded AppImage is larger than its release metadata.
linuxUpdates.error.downloadVerification: The AppImage download failed verification. Your existing version is unchanged.
